name: Stamped: an anti-travel game
source:
Stamped: an anti-travel game is an adaptation of the novel of (nearly) the same name, [url=https://kawikaguillermo.com/stamped/]Stamped: an anti-travel novel[/url], which won the 2020 Creative Prose Book Award at the Association of Asian American Studies. The game follows the journeys of six young, queer and racialized travelers whose paths intersect across Asian urban landscapes, and reimagines the rise of modern Asian cities through the hopes of North American minorities seeking to escape their race, class, and creed.

[From [url=https://drchrisp.itch.io/stamped-an-anti-travel-game]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Stamped：反旅行遊戲》改編自幾乎同名的小說[url=https://kawikaguillermo.com/stamped/]《Stamped：反旅行小說》[/url]。該小說曾獲美國亞裔研究協會2020年創意散文圖書獎。遊戲講述六位年輕的酷兒與有色族裔旅行者的旅程，他們的道路在亞洲的都市景觀中交匯；作品也藉此重新想像現代亞洲城市的崛起，呈現北美少數族裔試圖逃離種族、階級與信仰處境的願望。

[摘自[url=https://drchrisp.itch.io/stamped-an-anti-travel-game]Itch.io[/url]]
